# ADR-3217: AWS network: Public subnet placement for data store 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Public subnets expose databases to the internet path.

## Decision

Data stores MUST NOT use a public subnet placement for data store 1 (AWS-network-1).

## Consequences

Private subnets plus controlled ingress only.
